title: Target projection and derived-limit comparison preserve the actual pullback completion unit
statement:
Let $A$ be commutative Noetherian, $I$ finitely generated, $A/I$ additive torsion, and $P_n=A/I^n$ finite and perfect over $A$ for every $n\geq1$. For each scheme $T$ use the small pro-etale site, $A_T=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_T$, the ordinary unbounded module derived category, and strict towers [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $h:U\to V$ and $p:U\to W$ be any scheme morphisms, and $L\in D(A_V)$ derived $I$-complete. Put $E_0=Lh_A^*L$, $N=Rp_{*,A}E_0$, and $Z=Lh^*_{\mathrm{comp}}L$, with the specified completion unit $\gamma_h:E_0\to Z$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Write $\mathcal R_T(C)=\Delta_TC\otimes^L_{\Delta_TA_T}((P_n)_T)_n$ and $i_C:\Delta_TC\to\mathcal R_T(C)$ for the quotient augmentation. Let $F_T=R\lim_T$, $\lambda_C:C\to F_T\Delta_TC$ be its constant-tower map, and $u_C=F_T(i_C)\lambda_C$ [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality].
Put $Q_\bullet=Lh^*_{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_V(L)$, and let $t:Q_\bullet\simeq\mathcal R_U(E_0)$ be the representative-normalized reduction/pullback isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower]. Let $h_{E_0}:\mathcal R_W(N)\to Rp_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_U(E_0)$ be the counit-tensor projection mate on the ringed diagram sites, with the normalized constant-tower comparison $\chi_{E_0}:\Delta_WN\simeq Rp_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}\Delta_UE_0$ [lem-weil-pbc-augmented-diagram-projection-mate, lem-weil-pbc-constant-tower-pushforward-normalization]. Set $D_\bullet=Rp_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}Q_\bullet$ and $H'=Rp_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}(t^{-1})h_{E_0}$. For a strict tower $B$ on $U$, write $c_B:Rp_*F_UB\simeq F_WRp_*^{\mathrm{Tow}}B$ for exactly the canonical underived-composite-normalized comparison [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. Then the following identities hold with these actual maps:
$$F_U(t)\gamma_h=u_{E_0},\qquad F_W(h_{E_0})u_N=c_{\mathcal R_U(E_0)}Rp_*u_{E_0},$$
$$F_W(H')u_N=c_QRp_*(\gamma_h):N\longrightarrow F_WD_\bullet.$$
The statement requires no properness, constructibility, completeness of $E_0$ or $N$, or invertibility of $h_{E_0}$ or $\gamma_h$. In a cartesian square $\square=(f,f',g,g')$ with proper $f$ and a complete input $K$ with retained etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square, def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], taking $(p,h,L)=(f',g',K)$ identifies $H'$ and $c_Q$ with precisely the target projection comparison and target direct-image/limit comparison in [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization, def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map].
